title: Touch release on title screen throws on some tablets
description: TypeError when the finger leaves the canvas edge on the title screen.
root_cause: touchend can arrive with an empty changedTouches list.
fix_summary: Ignore touchend events without touches. (fixed before the studio fork)

title: Background scroll stutters on first launch
description: First 2-3 seconds after TAP TO START drop below 30 FPS on low-end devices.
root_cause: Tileset decoded lazily on first draw.
fix_summary: Decode the tileset before the first frame. (fixed before the studio fork)

title: Memory grows during long boss fights
description: JS heap grows ~15 MB per boss fight on mid-tier phones.
root_cause: Boss explosion sprites were allocated per frame.
fix_summary: Reuse a pooled explosion sprite. (fixed before the studio fork)

title: Slow first load on 3G
description: Time to first playable frame over 6 s on throttled 3G.
root_cause: Service worker cached every map file before the first frame.
fix_summary: Cache maps after the first frame. (fixed before the studio fork)

title: High score save fails in private browsing
description: QuotaExceededError when saving the high score in private windows.
root_cause: localStorage throws in private mode.
fix_summary: Wrap setItem in try/catch and show LOAD FAILED. (fixed before the studio fork)

title: Score digits overlap on 320 px wide screens
description: The 9-digit score runs into the energy counter.
root_cause: Fixed-width font assumed 8 px glyphs.
fix_summary: Shorter labels and padding. (fixed before the studio fork)

title: Area 5 difficulty spike around row 16
description: Playtesters lose lives in a cluster near row 16 of area 5.
root_cause: Enemy placement in that row left no safe lane.
fix_summary: Moved one enemy in the row.
